$(x+2)^3 = x^3 + 6x^2 + 12x + 8$

theorem rmo_2000_2
  (x y : ℕ)
  (hx : 0 < x)
  (hy : 0 < y)
  (h : y ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8) :
  x = 9 ∧ y = 11 := by
  -- First, we establish bounds by comparing with consecutive cubes
  -- For x ≥ 10, we show (x+2)³ < RHS < (x+3)³, so no solution exists
  have h_main : x = 9 ∧ y = 11 := by
    -- Case analysis based on the value of x
    by_cases hx_ge_10 : x ≥ 10
    · -- For x ≥ 10, show that (x+2)³ < y³ < (x+3)³, impossible
      have h1 : (x + 2) ^ 3 < x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by
        cases' le_or_lt x 10 with h_le_10 h_gt_10
        · contradiction
        · -- x ≥ 11
          have : x ≥ 11 := by omega
          norm_num at this ⊢
          ring_nf at h ⊢
          nlinarith [pow_pos hx 2, pow_pos hx 3]
      have h2 : x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 < (x + 3) ^ 3 := by
        cases' le_or_lt x 10 with h_le_10 h_gt_10
        · contradiction
        · have : x ≥ 11 := by omega
          norm_num at this ⊢
          ring_nf at h ⊢
          nlinarith [pow_pos hx 2, pow_pos hx 3]
      have h3 : (x + 2) ^ 3 < y ^ 3 := by
        calc
          (x + 2) ^ 3 < x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := h1
          _ = y ^ 3 := by rw [h]
      have h4 : y ^ 3 < (x + 3) ^ 3 := by
        calc
          y ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by rw [h]
          _ < (x + 3) ^ 3 := h2
      have h5 : x + 2 < y := by
        exact Nat.lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left (by omega) h3
      have h6 : y < x + 3 := by
        exact Nat.lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left (by omega) h4
      omega
    · -- For x < 10, check each case individually
      have hx_lt_10 : x ≤ 9 := by omega
      interval_cases x <;> norm_num at h ⊢ <;>
        (try omega) <;>
        (try {
          have : y ≤ 20 := by
            nlinarith [pow_pos hy 2, pow_pos hy 3]
          interval_cases y <;> norm_num at h ⊢ <;> omega
        })
  exact h_main

  (x y : ℕ)
  (hx : 0 < x)
  (hy : 0 < y)
  (h : y ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8) :

    have : 0 < 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by
      have hxpos : 0 < x := hx
      have hxpos' : 0 < x ^ 2 := Nat.pow_pos hxpos 2
      have : 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 ≥ 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x := by

      have hgt : 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x > 0 := by
        have : 8 * x ^ 2 > 6 * x := by
          have hxpos' : 0 < x := hx

            have : (8 * x) > 6 := by

        have : (x + 2) ^ 3 < x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 :=
